bound_design.thresholds_role: Read the six keyed F1 registry entries. No endpoint/threshold selection in this addon.

seedless_reference_candidate.rule: A85 same-scenes health reference: Q* on locked prefix100, compute/fingerprint once before any collection and inject the same object/value to paired arms.

analysis_procedure_candidate.unit: one independently generated complete seed; cells/episodes aggregate first
analysis_procedure_candidate.L2_and_L3_roles: evaluator-assisted/constructional ceilings, not L0 learner capability
analysis_procedure_candidate.orientation: explicit per endpoint and named treatment/reference, never lexical arm order
analysis_procedure_candidate.sign_test: two-sided exact binomial on exact non-ties; all ties null
analysis_procedure_candidate.wilcoxon: two-sided conditional-exact signed-rank, average ranks for ties, discard exact zeros; all zeros null
analysis_procedure_candidate.probability_of_improvement: number of strictly favorable seed-level differences divided by complete N, not bootstrap probability of mean
analysis_procedure_candidate.effect_size: Cohen dz with sample SD; zero spread null with reason
analysis_procedure_candidate.tail_candidate_convention: five largest contributions aligned with net direction, frozen-seed-order tie-break; zero net share null; report their share of net sum and mean without them
analysis_procedure_candidate.holm: complete prospectively frozen within-version contrast family; absent p/family cannot imply PASS
analysis_procedure_candidate.finding_rule: All original direction/sign-test, top5<0.50, CI/margin, companion and multiplicity guards remain. This module emits no verdict.
analysis_procedure_candidate.RMST: 1.5 quantitative benchmark only; P strict margin interval and separate T lowerCI>=-1.5 inclusive; no practical/equivalence/zero-harm claim
analysis_procedure_candidate.conjunction: FutureUtility benefit and Collateral bound and Retention persistence/non-inferiority and separate T harm; no weighted score
